name: 0.5% R6 hardware comparison against the independent equilibrated reference
selection: First 0.5% qualifying variant in each family's frozen protocol_cpu low-to-high order. Every RFM seed must qualify, deterministic methods use the frozen deterministic trajectory.
fd_implementations: Same FD4/SBDF2 spatial and temporal discretization, with fused BufferedFD and cached native band LU on CPU and audited resident native CUDA Graph with cached dense factors on GPU. A separate low-n audit found better single-step forward/backward residuals with power-of-two row scaling, without evidence of a changed 0.5% qualification or end-to-end performance. This experiment uses the previously validated unscaled candidate implementations.
timing: Five randomized blocks of six fresh in-process cold solves. End-to-end setup, transfers, plans, graph, marching, synchronized output and cleanup. No reference interpolation, scoring, Python import or driver disk cache reset inside the timed interval.
